operations.name: encode_string_api
operations.summary: Treat input bytes as UTF-8-like text payload (lossy/byte-preserving via C string sanitization) and exercise the high-level QR string encoders for normal QR and Micro QR, including structured variants and API version/cache helpers.
operations.input_format: Arbitrary bytes converted deterministically into a NUL-free C string by replacing interior 0x00 with ASCII 'A' and appending a trailing NUL; the payload text is then encoded through multiple string-oriented APIs.
operations.digest: Fold success/error status for each encoder call, QRcode fields/content-derived checksums from returned code buffers, structured list sizes, API version integers, and the returned version string bytes; never fold pointer values.

operations.name: encode_data_and_input
operations.summary: Use raw input bytes as binary payload and drive the lower-level QRinput construction path, duplication, configuration, splitting checks, byte-stream generation, direct encode-from-input, direct encode-from-data, and structured-input assembly.
operations.input_format: Opaque binary payload. The runner uses the full byte slice directly for byte-mode append/data APIs, and also derives a sanitized NUL-free text view for Split_splitStringToQRinput.
operations.digest: Fold return codes from all mutators/checkers, estimated bit counts, version/level getters, checksum of any produced byte stream, checksums of encoded QR matrices from direct and input-based encoders, and structured list sizes.

operations.name: spec_mask_ecc
operations.summary: Interpret a small header from the input to choose QR/MicroQR versions, levels, masks, and payload slices, then exercise specification queries, frame creation, masking, bitstream building, and Reed-Solomon ECC generation.
operations.input_format: Binary control block plus payload: first bytes are mapped deterministically into bounded version/level/mask/mode choices; remaining bytes feed BitStream and ECC routines. If too short, the runner substitutes safe defaults while still folding the actual input length/content.
operations.digest: Fold all scalar spec-query results, ECC spec integers, checksums of generated frame/mask buffers, bitstream output bytes, and ECC bytes produced by RSECC_encode, along with error/null indicators.

seed_strategy: For each operation, gen_seeds writes two deterministic, distinct valid files. encode_string_api gets two textual payloads with realistic QR content such as URL/contact-like ASCII and mixed alnum punctuation, both NUL-free. encode_data_and_input gets two binary payloads: one short structured business-card/message style byte sequence and one longer repeated-but-varied binary/text mix to exercise byte-mode and structured encoding. spec_mask_ecc gets two control-plus-payload files whose headers select different valid QR/MicroQR versions, levels, masks, and modes, followed by nontrivial payload bytes for bitstream/ECC work. All files are synthesized deterministically from fixed literals, not randomness.
